description: Find out which 1-Wire temperature sensor someone is warming: watches all thermometers and returns the one whose reading rose (by 1.0 °C by default). Use it to identify thermometers during setup: ask the user to hold one sensor in the hand (or warm it otherwise), then call this. Returns at the first clear rise, or after timeout_s (default 45, max 60) with the changes seen so far - call it again to keep waiting: the starting temperatures of an unfinished wait are kept for 5 minutes (reset=true starts fresh). The controller measures the sensors one after the other (one per "temperature polling" interval), so with many sensors a rise shows up slowly; the answer says how long a full round takes. Universal sensors (usens) are not watched. Changes nothing on the controller.

reset.description: forget the starting temperatures of an earlier unfinished wait

rise.description: how many °C a sensor must rise to count (default 1.0)

name: myio_wait_sensor
title: Find the sensor being warmed
